subject.title: Google Chat: Add user OAuth support for reactions and media uploads

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin support interactive per-user OAuth profiles, administrator-managed domain-wide delegation, or remain app-auth-only with degraded fallbacks?
rationale: These choices determine consent UX, credential storage, user attribution, impersonation authority, supported deployments, and the public configuration contract; source inspection cannot safely choose them without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add managed user OAuth profiles
options.body: Provide an explicit Google OAuth onboarding and auth-profile flow for user-scoped operations, with domain-wide delegation considered separately for managed deployments.

options.title: Support domain-wide delegation only
options.body: Use administrator-approved service-account impersonation for user-scoped operations, accepting that non-admin and personal deployments cannot use the feature.

options.title: Keep app authentication only
options.body: Retain the current service-account model and support only degraded alternatives such as text links and message-based typing indicators.

recommendation.title: Add managed user OAuth profiles
recommendation.body: Provide an explicit Google OAuth onboarding and auth-profile flow for user-scoped operations, with domain-wide delegation considered separately for managed deployments.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original channel work, remain active in the path, and supplied the strongest recent reviewer signal on this exact product decision.
